name: qima
description: QIMA — multi-organization / multi-unit Qur'an education platform.

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute qima-production --local --file=./database/seeds/0001_phase1_roles_permissions.sql && wrangler d1 execute qima-production --local --file=./database/seeds/0002_phase4_program_permissions.sql && wrangler d1 execute qima-production --local --file=./database/seeds/0003_phase5_activity_permissions.sql && wrangler d1 execute qima-production --local --file=./database/seeds/0004_phase6_participant_permissions.sql
scripts.db:seed:prod: wrangler d1 execute qima-production --remote --file=./database/seeds/0001_phase1_roles_permissions.sql && wrangler d1 execute qima-production --remote --file=./database/seeds/0002_phase4_program_permissions.sql && wrangler d1 execute qima-production --remote --file=./database/seeds/0003_phase5_activity_permissions.sql && wrangler d1 execute qima-production --remote --file=./database/seeds/0004_phase6_participant_permissions.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
